messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: http://microfluidics.utoronto.ca/papers/estrogen_assays.pdf[cite: 40]
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1126/scitranslmed.3000105[cite: 40]

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Droplet-Scale Estrogen Assays in Breast Tissue, Blood, and Serum (Liquid-Liquid Extraction and ELISA Readout)

REAGENTS USED:
  - Raw Sample (whole blood, serum, or breast tissue homogenate)
  - Lysing Solvent (DCM/acetone, 80:20 v/v)
  - Methanol (polar extraction and reconstitution solvent)
  - Isooctane (nonpolar extracting solvent)
  - ELISA Reagent

STEPS:
1. Sample Loading: Load 1 unit of raw sample into the sample reservoir and let it dry on the surface[cite: 45].
2. Lysis: Dispense lysing solvent, mix with the sample for 60s, heat at 23C for 1m, and dispose of the solvent; repeat this cycle 5 times[cite: 45].
3. Primary Extraction: Dispense methanol to dissolve the dried, lysed steroid residue and mix for 30s[cite: 45]. Deliver a unit droplet into the isooctane reservoir, mix for 20s for liquid-liquid extraction, and dispose of the isooctane[cite: 45].
4. Re-Extraction Pooling: Repeat the methanol extraction and isooctane clean-up cycle 4 times, pooling the extract droplets into the output reservoir[cite: 45].
5. Reconstitution: Dry the pooled extract by heating at 25C for 10m, then reconstitute with a unit of methanol and mix for 30s[cite: 45].
6. Detection: Dispense ELISA reagent, mix with the final extract for 60s, and detect fluorescence/readout for 5m before disposing of the mixture[cite: 45].

INTERPRETATION: Quantifies the concentration of estradiol extracted from biological samples via liquid-liquid extraction followed by an ELISA-based readout.

ir.content:
main:
	sample1[0] = dispense(raw_sample)
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI lyse1 = {lyse0,lyse2}
	PHI REPEAT_51 = {REPEAT_50,REPEAT_52}
	PHI sample2 = {sample1,sample3}
	if REPEAT_51[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	lyse2[0] = dispense(lysing_solvent)
	sample3[0] = mix(sample2[0], lyse2[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(sample3[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 60.0SECOND
	dispose(lyse2[0])
	REPEAT_52[0] = REPEAT_51[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	meoh1[0] = dispense(methanol)
	lysate1[0] = mix(sample2[0], meoh1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	octane1[0] = dispense(isooctane)
	extraction1[0] = mix(lysate1[0], octane1[0]) @ 20.0SECOND
	dispose(octane1[0])
bsbbr_5_h:
	PHI REPEAT_41 = {REPEAT_42,REPEAT_4}
	PHI lysate2 = {lysate3,lysate}
	PHI extraction2 = {extraction3,extraction}
	PHI meoh2 = {meoh3,meoh}
	PHI octane2 = {octane3,octane}
	if REPEAT_41[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_7_f
bsbbr_6_t:
	meoh3[0] = dispense(methanol)
	lysate3[0] = mix(sample2[0], meoh3[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	octane3[0] = dispense(isooctane)
	extraction3[0] = mix(extraction2[0], octane3[0]) @ 20.0SECOND
	dispose(octane3[0])
	REPEAT_42[0] = REPEAT_41[0] - 1
bsbbr_7_f:
	heat(extraction2[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
	recon1[0] = dispense(methanol)
	final_extract1[0] = mix(extraction2[0], recon1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	elisa1[0] = dispense(elisa_reagent)
	readout_mix1[0] = mix(final_extract1[0], elisa1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	estradiol_reading1[0] = detect(fluorescence, readout_mix1[0]) @ 300.0SECOND
	dispose(readout_mix1[0])
	NOP
